mapper.select: select p.*, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.created_at from patient p left join user u on p.user_id = u.id
select p.*, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.created_at from patient p left join user u on p.user_id = u.id where p.id = #{id}
select p.*, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.created_at from patient p left join user u on p.user_id = u.id where p.user_id = #{userId}
select p.*, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.created_at from patient p left join user u on p.user_id = u.id where p.phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
select p.*, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.created_at from patient p left join user u on p.user_id = u.id where p.identity_number = #{identityNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into patient(user_id, name, specific_role, id_status, phone_number, id_card_number, identity_number) values(#{userId}, #{name}, #{specificRole}, #{idStatus}, #{phoneNumber}, #{idCardNumber}, #{identityNumber})
